name: Banned | 200mg Single | Paradise Punch
description:
BANNED THC-infused gummy clusters, crafted for potency and consistency without compromising on flavor or high. Uniquely standing out, this gummy is the sole product in the state featuring an enticing nerds-filled center, setting it apart as an exceptional choice for value-conscious customers looking to enrich their brand preferences and enhance their purchases.
